title: PeroUQ: drift-diffusion modelling of perovskite solar cells with uncertainty quantification

creators.name: Abood, Mohammad Malik
creators.affiliation: Department of Radiological Techniques, College of Health and Medical Technology, University of Alkafeel, Najaf, Iraq

description: Open Python framework for experiment-calibrated, uncertainty-aware design of HTL-free FTO/ETL/MAPbI3/carbon perovskite solar cells: 1D drift-diffusion solver with mobile ions, Beer-Lambert and transfer-matrix optics, EQE, sourced parameter database, Bayesian calibration, Monte Carlo and Sobol analysis, and robust thickness design.
